description: This is a Python script used for encoding firmware images for MOXA IW devices. It reads a firmware file, partitions it into predefined segments, adds headers, computes CRCs, encrypts the combined data with XOR, and writes the encoded firmware to an output file.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: A dataclass representing a firmware partition with a name and size.

methods.name: bytes xor(data: bytes)
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts data using a XOR cipher with a predefined passphrase.

methods.name: bytes add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
methods.description: Constructs and prepends a firmware header containing metadata and offsets.

methods.name: bytes add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int)
methods.description: Constructs and prepends a file header with filename, size, CRC, and other metadata.

methods.name: int crc(data: bytes, init_val: int)
methods.description: Calculates a CRC32 checksum with an XOR initial value.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates reading firmware, partitioning, adding headers, encryption, and writing output.

ctags.name: add_file_header
ctags.pattern: /^def add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int) -> bytes:$/

ctags.name: add_fw_header
ctags.pattern: /^def add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int,$/
ctags.signature: (data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
